description: Parse SSH auth.log lines into structured fields

patterns: %{TIMESTAMP_ISO8601:event.created} %{SYSLOGHOST:host.hostname} sshd(-session)?\[%{POSINT:process.pid}\]: %{WORD:event.action} password for (invalid user )?%{USERNAME:user.name} from %{IP:source.ip} port %{NUMBER:source.port} %{WORD:network.protocol}
